problem: Near-identical to b-007: player reports feeling calmer/lighter up here and Linus deflects the credit to 'the mountain', same structure and same move.
fix: Keep the credit-to-nature idea but carry it through a different image (the quiet, the slowness) and vary the player's opener so it does not mirror b-007.

problem: 'thank you, for climbing up to say so. Most never do' is the recurring gratitude-closer also used in b-020, b-041, b-085 and b-095.
fix: Vary or drop the 'you climbed up, most never do' closer here so the beat does not appear across so many rows.

problem: Duplicates b-005: player brings bread/loaf from town and Linus replies with the same warms-twice sentiment ('A gift shared warms twice' vs b-005 'A shared crust warms more than the belly').
fix: Change the gift (a foraged trade, a mended tool) or drop the 'warms twice' aphorism; keep only one bread-from-town gift row in the set.

problem: Reuses exemplar v09's signature line near-verbatim ('contentment is not out there to be chased. It is here, to be noticed') and piles onto the batch's heavy to-be-noticed motif (b-038, b-052, b-086).
fix: Replace with a fresh contentment image not built on chase/notice, e.g. contentment that settles in once the wanting quiets.

problem: The dusk-cliff postcard ('the water below turns to glass, and the first stars come out... Evening is the mountain's reward') reuses the same evening-water-transformation scene as b-030 ('The water goes gold... the whole valley holds its breath').
fix: Shift this row to a different sensory detail (the sound of the water, the cooling air) or a non-evening moment to break up the cliff-at-dusk cluster.

problem: 'The truest ones usually are' repeats b-031's 'The best ones usually are' as the same reply frame to a player remark about his answer/lesson.
fix: Answer the 'simple answer' line differently, without the 'the [X] ones usually are' cadence.

problem: 'It is the center of everything up here' reframes the fire as the heart/center of camp exactly as b-012 does ('It is the heart of the camp, and a heart wants tending').
fix: Give this fire-tending row a distinct angle from b-012, e.g. the ritual of lighting it rather than its centrality.

problem: 'Time spent being present is never wasted' leans on modern mindfulness phrasing ('being present'), off his plainer idiom.
fix: Use his own words, e.g. 'Time spent fully where you are is never wasted', matching b-023.

problem: 'Peace is mostly a matter of stopping the argument with how things are' is modern acceptance-therapy phrasing and redundant with the plainer 'Winter is winter. I let it be' that follows it.
fix: Cut the therapized aphorism and let the 'winter is winter, I let it be' line carry the thought.

problem: Closely duplicates b-016 (both 10 hearts): same 'I never dared hope for a friend, now I have one' arc and the identical 'Come, warm your hands' plus tea/kettle closer.
fix: Differentiate the emotional beat (built peace vs found friendship) and replace the 'warm your hands / kettle' closer with a different gesture.

problem: Double-borrows: 'makes the world new for a morning' echoes b-052, and 'Snow makes the whole mountain hold its breath' echoes b-030's 'the whole valley holds its breath'.
fix: Recast the snow-walk with fresh imagery, dropping both the 'world new' and 'holds its breath' phrasings.

problem: 'the mountain is a patient school, and I was a willing student' repeats b-031's 'the wild is a patient teacher' metaphor.
fix: Keep the strong 'the fewer things a man owns, the fewer things own him' line and swap the patient-teacher tail for a non-teaching image.

problem: 'Gratitude is a muscle, and mine has had years of exercise' is a modern gym/self-help metaphor, out of Linus's nature-grounded idiom.
fix: Recast gratitude through his own world, e.g. a habit the seasons taught him, kept warm like a fire he tends daily.

problem: The high-heart payoff 'I passed so many evenings alone... You reminded me' is the same 'long alone, you changed that' beat repeated across b-016, b-048, b-056, b-088, b-095 and b-100.
fix: Keep the sentiment but make this instance's imagery distinct, and trim how many high-heart rows land on this exact beat.

problem: Doubles up on batch patterns: 'You cannot hurry a season'-style can't-hurry lesson repeats b-031, and 'Take one thing slower... and notice' repeats the homework-cadence close of b-070 and b-066.
fix: Replace both the can't-hurry lesson and the 'take one thing' prescription with a fresher, less instructional response.

problem: 'It costs nothing but the climb' uses the same 'costs nothing but a X' frame as b-053 ('costs nothing but a morning's picking'), part of a costs-nothing/comes-free cluster (b-024, b-046).
fix: Praise the free view without the 'costs nothing but...' construction.
